issue.title: [AEGIS] Flask application running in debug mode on all interfaces
issue.body:
## Summary
- Severity: **medium** (confidence 1)
- Rule: `python.flask.security.audit.app-run-param-config.avoid_app_run_with_bad_host` · CWE: CWE-489
- Location: `app.py:36-36` @ c5fbff5

## What is wrong
In app.py:36, the application is configured to run with `debug=True` and `host="0.0.0.0"`. This exposes the application on all network interfaces with the interactive Werkzeug debugger enabled, allowing anyone who can reach port 5080 to trigger exceptions and execute arbitrary code.

## Impact
An attacker on the network can exploit the Flask/Werkzeug interactive debugger to execute arbitrary Python code on the server.

## Recommended fix
Disable debug mode by setting `debug=False` or removing it, and bind to `127.0.0.1` instead of `0.0.0.0` unless external access is strictly required: `app.run(host="127.0.0.1", port=5080, debug=False)`

## Evidence
```
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5080, debug=True)
```
Semgrep: Running flask app with host 0.0.0.0 could expose the server publicly.

_Filed autonomously by AEGIS agent **aegis-sentinel-01** on Guild.ai. Push a fix and I will re-scan and close this issue._
